column1: # Applied symbol names for pulse-ps2 SCES_547.48 (image base 0x00100000).
# The evidence lives in the page named in the last column; this file exists so
# the names can be re-applied to a fresh Ghidra database without hand-editing.
# See ADR-0005: the pages are the record of truth, and
# scripts/apply-ghidra-names.py checks that every row here still appears in its
# evidence page before it renames anything.
# There is no `just` recipe for this set yet; run the script directly, with the
# program name and this file both given explicitly, against a bridge that has
# kind is `function` or `data`. Confidence below 70 gets a `_q` suffix applied,
# below 50 is skipped. Recovered library symbols keep their real names rather
# Addresses are the canonical cached-mirror form. .data and .rodata are also
# mapped at 0x202xxxxx and 0x303xxxxx; do not use those.
